Targ. Y. Lev. XIII, 24 סוּמְקָא (ed. Amst. סוֹמְ׳) red spot; a. e.—

<cite ref="Pesachim 25b:4">Pes. 25ᵇ</cite>, a. e. <he>מאי חזית דדמא דידך ס׳ טפי וכ׳</he> what reason hast thou to assume that thy blood is redder? may be thy neighbor’s blood is redder, i.e. you dare not save your life at the expense of your fellowman’s life.
<cite ref="Shabbat 134a:12">Sabb. 134ᵃ</cite> <he>האי ינוקא דס׳</he> an infant that looks red.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 58b:12">B. Mets. 58ᵇ</cite>, v. <cite ref="H00686"><he>חִיוָּר</he></cite>; a. fr.—

<cite ref="Yevamot 64b:17">Yeb. 64ᵇ</cite> <he>יצחק סומקא</he> surname of R. Isaac ben Joseph.—Pl. <he>סוּמָּקִין</he>, <he>סוּמְּקִין</he>, <cite ref="O00353"><he>סוּמְּקֵי</he></cite>, <cite ref="O00351"><he>סוּמְ׳</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on II Kings 3:22">Targ. II Kings III, 22</cite>; a. e.—

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sanhedrin 1:2:14">Y. Snh. I, 18ᶜ</cite> bot.; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Rosh Hashanah 2:5:3">Y. R. Hash. II, 58ᵇ</cite> top (not <cite ref="O00341"><he>סומוקן</he></cite>).
Sabb. 147ᵃ חיורי וס׳ white or red garments; a. fr.—Fem. סוּמְּקָא, סוּמְקְתָא.
